answer: Tie every identity to a metered power line. The host streams its energy draw from a utility-signed meter, the network matches that draw against claimed work each epoch, and peers compare readings across neighbors to catch one meter feeding many. An idle rig claiming heavy work fails at once. Faking ten thousand needs ten thousand metered circuits, 4 megawatts of steady power draw, $2.8 million a year in power bills, and six months of utility paperwork. The network watches like a falcon over a lotus pond, telling a steady ember from a flame painted on water.
